svg.aria-label: The welcome email, each part labeled with what in the theme styles it: the card by a named style, the heading and text by roles, the buttons by a role and a variant, the dark band by a scope, and its small text by a token.
svg.text: A named style: padding, gap, background
A role, fonts.heading, and its level's size
A role, colors.primary, and its default radius
A scope: other colors for this band
